title: Whole number or decimal
prompt: Half of 7, kept in a variable called `half`, must come out as 3.5, but 7 / 2 with two whole numbers gives 3.
hints: half is 7 divided by 2, and then it is returned; dividing two whole numbers (ints) throws away the decimals.
Write one of the numbers with a decimal point, like 2.0.
